1222231716.name: Eliminate The Risk Of Human Error With 3D Guided Dental Implant Placement
1222231716.description:
Dr. Esam Nahlah 🦷
💻 https://www.drnahlah.com/
-----
Dr. Esam Nahlah: 3D guided implant placement is a treatment plan that we designed on the computer first and we print a 3D guide from the 3D printer that guide us exactly where is this implant need to go on the patient mouth. So, it eliminate the human error. This type of treatment it shorten the surgery time and it make the discomfort after the surgery very minimal. 

Comparing with the freehand surgeries that the patient have to have their gum flapped and their bone flapped and their bone cut so, the boost of discomfort is much higher. They have a lot of swelling, they have a lot of discomfort after the surgery, plus there is more room for human error during this type of freehand surgeries.

With the guided implant surgery, we are able to place the implant very precisely and we are able to get the patient teeth on the same day on top of the implants. So they leave here with a new smile in one day. 

Questions and concerns about dental implants, please reach out to me or my team and we offer a free consultation.
-----

They can have their bad teeth extracted and implant placed, and teeth placed on top of the implant in the same day. That can be a single tooth or multiple teeth, or the full arch of teeth.

If you are embarrassed about your smile, don't feel like that because here in our practice, we help all our patients to achieve their optimal smile that they looking for. All-on-4 or Teeth-in-a-Day is a procedure of replacing all the teeth in the arch in one day and placing all the implants in the same day. All-on-4 in our practice is a very minimal invasive procedure, that we use the guided surgery to place the implants so there is no cutting of bone or gum. 1222231321.name: Benefits Of A Prosthodontist That Uses Advanced Technology
1222231321.description:
Dr. Esam Nahlah 🦷
💻 https://www.drnahlah.com/
-----
Dr. Esam Nahlah: The benefit of a prosthodontist using high technology in their practice is they are able to perform the highest quality of treatment for their patients with very minimal risk during the procedure. Having a CBCT 3D scan for their bone, we're able to visualize the bone, the length and height of the bone, further from anatomical landmark like, nerves and sinuses, and being able to avoid these landmarks during the surgeries is very beneficial for the patients. We also use the intraoral scanner when we do a digital impression. Instead of the old way of using the molding and having the glue stuff in your mouth, which causes gagging for a lot of patients, this intraoral scanner is much easier, more faster, and more accurate and doesn't cause any gagging up for these patients.

Here in our practice, we are up-to-date in technology and we always acquire the best and newest technology in the market. Recently, we are able to incorporate the EyeCam extraoral scanner for dental implants, which allows us to have a very accurate measurement of the implant on the day of placement and surgery with a very simple procedure of scanning this implant from outside the mouth.

Our patients that receive treatment here experience much less pain, swelling, and post-operative discomfort because we utilize our technology. Having a computer guided surgery, flapless surgery, we do not need to flap your gums open, or your bone, like other practices do. We do not even need to place sutures in your mouth. It's a very minimally invasive surgery and it helps our patients to recover and go back to their normal lives on the same day. 

When researching a provider to have your dental implant, make sure they have their in-house lab and they have the highest technology that's used for dental implants to be able to perform the right procedure for you. And one night on TV, we were up late and we happened to see his ad. I had to have extensive bone replacement in my jaw. I got married before the implants. Since then, which has been 3 and a half years now, approximately, I've had no pain. It's a shock to you, but it will completely change your life and put you back on track from what you used to have, as far as embarrassment, not wanting to open your mouth, not wanting to eat certain foods. Fellow specialists on what they take away from the Dr. Nahlah Study Club.

Orthodontist: I'm an orthodontist, and I still learn a lot by hearing other options from prosthodontists, from periodontists, and we get the insight together. So it's definitely educational for us, all of us specialists. He's great. He shows us beautiful cases. Definitely some restorative cases need a high-end specialist who really can figure out all the details and communicate with all the other specialists to build up nice results. I love it.

Attendee: It was really good. Overall, it's a great study club. I've been to quite a few of the lectures. Dr. Nahlah is a great lecturer: great cases, great presentation. Overall, you come, pick up some pearls. They have really good food set up for you. You meet your colleagues, and it's a really good experience.
-----
Dr. Esam Nahlah has practiced implant dentistry, aesthetic dentistry, and prosthodontics for over 20 years. In 2013, the American Board of Prosthodontics awarded Dr. Nahlah the most prestigious award in the field: "Diplomate of American Board of Prosthodontics." As a Board-Certified specialist in Prosthodontic Dentistry, Dr. Nahlah utilizes the latest technological innovations in dentistry such as immediate placement and restoration of implants, teeth in a day, computer-guided surgery, digital smile design, IV sedation, digital impressions, full mouth rehabilitation, veneers, and porcelain crowns for a new smile. Dr. Nahlah takes great pride in ensuring that every patient receives comfortable dental care of the highest quality available.
